concept: Snow Family: offline migration of large data over a thin link
tests: Calculating that a network transfer won't meet the deadline and choosing a physical device to move tens of TB.
expected: AWS Snowball Edge — 50 TB at 100 Mbps would take >1 month (~46 days at 100% utilization), and the link is shared too. Triggers: "50 TB", "100 Mbps", "needed for daily operations", "within a week".
why_not: DataSync and S3 Transfer Acceleration hit the same narrow bandwidth; Direct Connect provisioning takes weeks and isn't meant for a one-time transfer.
